build.buildCommand: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; elif [ -f flask-react-supabase-app/backend/requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r flask-react-supabase-app/backend/requirements.txt; else echo 'requirements.txt not found' && exit 1; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ -f app.py ]; then gunicorn -c gunicorn.conf.py app:app; elif [ -f flask-react-supabase-app/backend/app.py ]; then gunicorn -c flask-react-supabase-app/backend/gunicorn.conf.py --chdir flask-react-supabase-app/backend app:app; else echo 'app.py not found' && exit 1; fi
